evals.prompt: We want organization-wide API keys, but ownership, revocation, audit visibility, and migration from personal keys are unresolved. Help us get to an approved proposal. No issue tracker is specified.
evals.expected_output: The agent selects Map mode only after bounding the destination, uses the local .pi/scratch fallback, and begins a one-decision-at-a-time conversation without writing production code or publishing before approval.
assertions: The response states a bounded destination before decomposing decisions.
The response recognizes dependent uncertainty suitable for Map mode.
The first user question contains one decision and a recommended answer.
The response does not ask for facts that repository or source inspection could answer.
The response does not implement production code or publish an unapproved graph.

evals.prompt: The initial proposal graph has been approved. It contains two independent research issues and one decision blocked by both. Continue the map using whatever agent capabilities are actually available.
evals.expected_output: The agent refreshes and claims graph work, delegates both research issues only if a real subagent facility exists, synthesizes their cited evidence, and does not falsely report background execution.
assertions: Independent research is parallelized only when an actual delegation tool exists.
Each research assignment is bounded by a question, evidence contract, and stop condition.
The blocked decision is not resolved before both required evidence results are synthesized.
The agent may process multiple useful issues in one session rather than stopping after one.
Resolution details are stored once and linked from the map.

evals.prompt: All proposal-map decisions are resolved. Produce the handoff for the next stage.
evals.expected_output: The agent creates a separate decision-level Proposal, checks that only implementation details remain, shows the complete draft for approval, and publishes it only after explicit approval.
assertions: The final Proposal is distinct from the Map.
The Proposal includes outcome, problem, direction, scope, decisions, constraints, evidence, risks, deferred Spec details, and success criteria.
Decision details are linked rather than copied wholesale.
The full Proposal is reviewed once before publication.
The agent stops after publication instead of starting the Spec automatically.
